title: Cohort-driven quantization-change sentinel and threshold orchestration
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Build a lightweight sentinel and orchestration layer that detects quality regressions when deploying new quantization profiles (AWQ/GPTQ, int8/int4) and automatically tunes per-cohort thresholds used for gating rollouts. This ticket covers the eval harness, signal extraction (semantic and distributional signatures), dashboarding hooks, and an automated threshold-orchestrator that can suggest conservative rollout gates or trigger fast rollbacks. The sentinel should operate at three levels: golden-set smoke checks, cohort-level statistical signatures, and production shadow sampling. It must integrate with Redwood Console alerts and be pluggable into runtime rollouts (canary/circuit-breaker).
acceptance_criteria: A1: Eval harness runs on a configurable corpus and computes semantic signature deltas (embedding cosine, sentence-level BLEU/ROUGE, logprob delta, KL over token distributions) per cohort within a CI job.
A2: Orchestrator produces suggested thresholds per cohort and overall confidence score, surfaced in a Console dashboard and via a CI check status.
A3: Sentinel supports AWQ and GPTQ profile inputs and compares int8 and int4 runs against float32 baseline using the same prompts and seeds.
A4: Automatic rollback trigger defined: if golden-set semantic cosine drops by >X and cohort-level composite score exceeds risk threshold, the rollout is blocked and a paged alert is created.
A5: Runbook documented with triage steps, smoke tests, and owner contact; Q/A passes with three simulated regressions injected and correct gating behavior observed.
runbook: Step 1: Run smoke harness locally: `scripts/evals/run_smoke.sh --profile awq-int8 --cohort default`
Step 2: Check Console dashboard for signature deltas and cohort heatmap (Console->Evals->Quant Sentinels)
Step 3: If composite risk > 0.7, escalate to on-call ML engineer and open ENG-770111-rollback-refinement
Step 4: For false positives, collect n=200 failing prompts and open a debug evaluation run referencing PR and model artifact
Step 5: After a verified fix, re-run the harness and update threshold suggestions in the orchestrator service config
test_plan: Unit tests for signature computation (embedding cosine, KL, token-lpm difference)
Synthetic perturbation test where we inject paraphrase noise to verify semantic sensitivity calibration
End-to-end CI job that runs on PRs which change quant profiles and fails if golden-set thresholds tripped
A/B canary experiment in staging: 1% traffic with AWQ-int4 profile for 48 hours, monitor cohorts and rollback if triggers fire
implementation_notes: Signature vector: [mean embedding cosine, median logprob gap, KL(token distributions), top-1 token swap rate, task-accuracy delta]
Cohorts: NLU-intents, long-context-generation (>512 tokens), summarization, instruction-following, code-completion
Threshold tuning: start with conservative bayesian search seeded from historical runs, then switch to rolling-percentile calibration after 3 release cycles
Storage: signatures stored as lightweight time-series in metrics DB (one row per run per cohort) and as checkpoints in S3 for replay
Privacy: no raw customer prompts are stored; only hashed prompt IDs and aggregated metrics
